subject: world_language
concept: Naming common animals in the target language
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student points to animal pictures/toys and names each in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an animal word to its picture
exercise.abstract: Student names a described animal in the target language

misconception_flags: confuses similar-sounding animal words in the target language

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
